title: Oriion Wave-Transition Gate Frontmatter
description: Schema for wave-N-to-N+1.md YAML frontmatter per ADR-025 section 1 and GRILL-DECISIONS-ORIION section 5.1 DECISION-9. Validates the machine-readable header that memory-curator auto-fills (80%) and founder hand-signs (20%).

gate.description: Transition identifier in form wave-N-to-N+1 where N in [0..4]

status.description: PENDING = open and awaiting evaluation; PASSED = founder approved after thresholds met; BLOCKED = thresholds not met and remediation in progress; WAIVED = founder explicit override with justification in body

opened_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when gate file was first created and status set to PENDING

closed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when status transitioned away from PENDING; null while PENDING

founder_signature.description: Required when status in [PASSED, WAIVED]; null when PENDING or BLOCKED. Format: free-form founder identifier plus optional cryptographic signature (out of scope for v1).

hard_thresholds.description: Wave-specific must-pass criteria per ADR-025 section 1. Keys are threshold identifiers; values describe target, actual reading, pass/fail, and evidence link.

target.description: Required threshold value (numeric KPI, boolean flag, or string sentinel)

actual.description: Measured value at gate evaluation time; null while PENDING

evidence_url.description: Pointer to evidence artifact (dashboard snapshot, recording, dataset)

description.description: Human-readable rationale for this threshold; preserved for audit

deliverables.description: Wave deliverables tracked by memory-curator; status auto-synced from roadmap and phase artifacts

metrics_snapshot.description: Auto-filled by memory-curator at gate evaluation time. Captures observability KPIs in effect when gate was scored.

adr_delta.description: ADRs created, revised, or superseded during this wave

risks_delta.description: Risk register changes during this wave; identifiers reference .planning/risks/

capacity_snapshot.description: Team-AI capacity state at gate evaluation; informs cost-budget review and staffing decisions for next wave

ai_team_roles_active.description: Count of distinct agent archetypes active during this wave
